scope_of_negative_conclusion: This packet does not justify a materially new task-linked theory route. This is neither a proof that no such route exists nor an assessment of the unseen primary candidate. It does not stop separately justified research or change old L4.
facts_taken_from_packet_not_freshly_reau: Original fixed-cohort, five-seed ordinary L4 supports trained-head utility versus uniform and fixed-head dependence under the declared context permutation, with its recorded t-test assumptions and sign-flip limitation.
The historical donor replay holds the recipient readout fixed; the independent attainable coadaptation counterexample is already complete.
Mixed-effect attainability is neither original-circuit membership nor a sufficient or necessary explanation of donor harm.
The finite role-rank boundary and its mass/clipping/nonlinear-control qualifications are already complete. They are not proposed again.

reason_no_route_selected.task_premise_missing: No new task-level structural assumption is supplied: no independently supported conditional independence, evidence-generation law, label-preserving operation with controlled encoder behavior, or restriction that removes alternative information channels. The architecture and aggregate metrics do not supply such an assumption.
reason_no_route_selected.causal_link_missing: The packet does not identify a variable whose intervention changes the proposed useful mechanism while keeping the relevant competing task channels controlled. Hidden features already encode entity markers, utilities are jointly trained, and attention mass/outside-context effects remain live. Assigning one of these channels the role of nuisance would be an additional empirical hypothesis, not a deduction.
reason_no_route_selected.theorem_target_missing: A theorem about utility needs a task distribution or a decision-family premise; a theorem about functional identifiability needs an explicitly chosen observational/intervention family. Neither a novel such premise nor a new consequent is justified here. Adding a synthetic distribution selected to favor the head would establish a capability witness, not explain the reported task result.
reason_no_route_selected.prediction_missing: No new out-of-sample or controlled-intervention prediction follows from the available aggregate facts. A prediction obtained by recomputing logits from saved alpha and utilities verifies arithmetic, while a prediction read off the old validation outcomes is descriptive. Neither supplies independent discrimination.
reason_no_route_selected.novelty_missing: The remaining immediately available derivations fall into the packet's closed known-tool families. A new name, a sharper finite witness, or an extra bound would not establish a substantively new task mechanism. No original-paper novelty audit was performed in this no-network pass.

assumptions_i_decline_to_add_without_evi: That a nonentity token's frozen contextual feature is free of entity or label-relevant information.
That an attention change leaves the complementary mass/readout channels irrelevant to the task.
That a hidden-feature role manipulation is realized by a valid raw-text manipulation with unchanged h or unchanged gold relation.
That the learned circuit operates in a special small-angle, latent-mixture, weak-dependence, sparse-witness or other favorable regime not shown in this packet.
That an apparent donor deficit after a chosen fitting procedure is necessarily missing information rather than optimization, regularization, sample variation or selection.

classical_equivalence_and_controls.not_a_rejection_reason: Exact classical simulation or lack of speedup does not reject an ordinary Q-RMEA theory-empirical contribution. Quantum necessity is not imposed as an extra acceptance requirement.
classical_equivalence_and_controls.what_controls_would_have_to_discriminate: Any later premise must distinguish its proposed causal link from generic nonlinear scoring, matched readout/optimization effects and the already strong real-overlap/dephased controls. If it claims only a general nonnegative reweighting effect, controls should test that ordinary claim rather than demand an artificial quantum separation.
classical_equivalence_and_controls.why_no_control_is_proposed_now: There is no selected causal estimand or new theory target to determine a scientifically matched control. Choosing a control before choosing that target risks engineering a favorable but uninformative comparison.

already_closed: Normalized Rayleigh, PGM and convex-loss identities
Generic coadaptation and recoverable readout changes
known_neighbor_collision_status.new_literature_claims: None. The negative recommendation is evidence-bounded; it is not a claim that the literature exhausts every possible Q-RMEA contribution.

minimal_condition_for_reopening_this_adv.required_scientific_input: Supply one independently motivated task premise and one mechanism variable not already settled by the closed results. State what task event that variable should change, what competing channel is controlled, and why the operation preserves the intended label/task interpretation.
minimal_condition_for_reopening_this_adv.precise_target_gate: Before a diagnostic, write the exact conditional theorem or causal design target and the observable that would fail it. The observable must not be a tautological replay identity, an arbitrary finite capability witness, or an outcome-selected subgroup.
minimal_condition_for_reopening_this_adv.discriminating_prediction_gate: Commit to a signed or equivalence prediction, its comparison family and a failure rule before seeing the deciding outcomes. A non-Born classical equivalent can remain a valid control without invalidating an ordinary-method claim.
minimal_condition_for_reopening_this_adv.minimum_evidence_gate: An independent source for the task premise and then the smallest evidence capable of separating its two live explanations. The packet does not determine that sample, endpoint or intervention, so no diagnostic specification or run is justified in this advice.
minimal_condition_for_reopening_this_adv.no_execution_request: These are conditions under which a new question would become meaningful, not a proposed experiment, resource request, permission escalation or instruction to acquire private data.

stop_conditions: Stop if the proposed result is only another application of a closed known identity or the completed counterexamples.
Stop if the claim requires silently suppressing entity, encoder, mass or readout channels present in the actual method.
Stop causal or generalization promotion if the deciding observation remains outcome-guided reuse of the same historical validation examples.
If a changed model, training rule or task is introduced, require evidence for that changed object; do not transfer old L4's utility conclusion automatically.
If a candidate has a genuinely new premise and a falsifiable consequence, assess it on its own evidence rather than treating this packet-level stop as a universal block.

independence_and_execution.file_operations: Input/output reading and hashing plus creation of the two requested advice files only.
